transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____ . What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. Well, I suppose I’m here because... for nearly two years now, I’ve been absolutely sure that our contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. 

They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many receipts my husband tries to show me, or how many excuses those people come up with, I just know what they're doing. So, my husband wanted me to come talk to you about it.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people around you could not hear?
No, I haven't. I don't hear any voices or anything like that. It's just... well, it's just what I see them doing, and the way they act. But no, no sounds or voices that aren't there.
Before these beliefs started, did you ever have a brain injury, stroke, seizure, or another medical problem affecting your brain?

No, nothing like that. I've never had a stroke, or a seizure, or any kind of head injury. My health has always been pretty normal. There's really nothing wrong with my brain, Doctor... I just know what I'm seeing them do with my house.
Does your husband also believe that the contractor and neighbors are conspiring to cheat you?

No, he doesn't. He... well, he thinks I'm just getting worked up over normal construction delays. Like I mentioned, he keeps showing me the paperwork and the receipts, trying to explain it all away. He just doesn't see what they're doing behind our backs. I think he's just tired of hearing me talk about it, to be honest... which is why he wanted me to come see you.
Have these beliefs affected your work, social life, or day-to-day functioning?

No, not really. Aside from all the stress with the remodel and trying to figure out what they're up to, my day-to-day life is pretty much the same. I still go to my church gatherings and my book club. I keep up with the house and still see my family just like I always do. It's just this one thing with the house that's taking up so much of my time and energy.
Have you had any other unusual experiences, like feeling that your thoughts are being controlled, that your thoughts are being broadcast, or that other people can hear your thoughts?

No, definitely not. I haven't experienced anything like that. My thoughts are my own. Nobody is controlling them, and no one can hear what I'm thinking. Like I said, I'm just dealing with what is actually happening right in front of me with those contractors. But no, nothing unusual going on in my head.
